title: (RHSA-2019:2548) Important: OpenShift Container Platform 4.1 jenkins security update
portal_summary:
An update for jenkins is now available for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.1.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Important. A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE link(s) in the References section.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.1|x86_64
portal_description:
Jenkins is a continuous integration server that monitors executions of repeated jobs, such as building a software project or jobs run by cron.

Security Fix(es):

* jenkins: CSRF protection tokens did not expire (CVE-2019-10353)

* jenkins: Arbitrary file write vulnerability using file parameter definitions (CVE-2019-10352)

* jenkins: Unauthorized view fragment access (CVE-2019-10354)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
